summary: A parent's microphone is cut at the time limit and the board president says the board controls who speaks.
realLife: At a school board meeting a parent was given two minutes, her microphone cut shortly after, and the board said it has complete discretion over speakers; other parents protested.
sources: The Millstone (Substack), HSE board president to parents: https://themillstone.substack.com/p/hse-board-president-to-parents-be
inGame: a protest formed by the public-action engine with its officials at the edge; needs: meeting time-limit rules

turns.summary: The president lets the parent finish.
turns.writesBack: a small goodwill; the parent stays calm

turns.summary: The parent leaves and starts a flyer drive.
turns.writesBack: a new cause shared with neighbors

turns.summary: The president moves to the next speaker.
